title: MAST: Motif-Augmented Diffusion with Search Tree for Spectroscopic Molecular Structure Elucidation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Elucidating molecular structures from spectra is a foundational problem in chemical and materials characterization, yet remains challenging due to spectral ambiguity and the vast molecular space. Although recent diffusion-based generators show strong promise for spectra-conditioned elucidation, existing methods struggle to learn robust spectra-structure relationships from limited paired data when relying solely on global spectral representation. Moreover, the repeated full sampling inference strategy incurs substantial computation overhead. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{MAST}, a \textbf{M}otif-\textbf{A}ugmented diffusion framework with \textbf{S}earch \textbf{T}ree, for joint 2D-3D spectroscopic molecular structure elucidation. MAST introduces explicit, interpretable \emph{motif priors} as intermediate evidences throughout denoising, reducing conditional ambiguity and facilitating spectra-conditioned optimization. W

translated_title: MAST：基于模体增强扩散与搜索树的光谱分子结构解析
translated_abstract: 从光谱中解析分子结构是化学与材料表征领域的一个基础性问题，但由于光谱的模糊性和庞大的分子空间，该问题仍然极具挑战性。尽管近年来基于扩散模型的生成器在光谱条件下的结构解析中展现出巨大潜力，但现有方法在仅依赖全局光谱表示时，难以从有限的成对数据中学习到稳健的光谱-结构关系。此外，重复的完整采样推理策略会带来巨大的计算开销。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了 MAST——一种带有搜索树的模体增强扩散框架，用于2D-3D联合的光谱分子结构解析。MAST 在整个去噪过程中引入显式、可解释的模体先验作为中间证据，降低了条件模糊性，并促进了光谱条件下的优化。
tldr: MAST提出了一种结合模体先验与搜索树的扩散框架，通过在去噪过程中引入显式可解释的模体证据，实现更准确且计算高效的2D-3D光谱分子结构解析。
en_tdlr: MAST proposes a motif-augmented diffusion framework with a search tree that introduces explicit, interpretable motif priors as intermediate evidence during denoising, enabling more accurate and computationally efficient joint 2D-3D spectroscopic molecular structure elucidation.
